Name: Harvey Refined
Author: Chrysanthe
Description:
[img]http://i.imgur.com/qMD3H4w.gif[/img] [size=6][b]Harvey Refined [/b][/size]
[color=#e06666]Updated for SDV ver 1.4 and now compatible with CP.[/color]

Harvey is the next target for sprite improvement!!
He's always looked monstrous and weird so I decided to beautify him.
I edited his hair to be more accurate and also went with another approach to glasses. It worked out nicely.
His jacket/coat has also been shortened and the coat tails removed (those suit Elliott more).

[b][u][size=3]2/14/17: [/size][/u][/b]Also uploaded an optional version with a mustache as requested.

[u][size=3][b]Instructions for SMAPI & CP:[/b][/size][/u]
. [url=https://smapi.io/]Install the latest version of SMAPI[/url] and then [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1915]Content Patcher[/url].
. Download this mod and unzip the folder into Stardew Valley/Mods.
. Run the game using SMAPI.
[b][u][size=3]
Instructions for [u][size=3].xnb (no SMAPI):[/size][/u][/size][/u][/b]
. This mod replaces the original Harvey.xnb sprite. Please make a backup of the original file if necessary.
. Unzip or extract the [i]Harvey.xnb[/i] file after downloading.
. Place the file into the Stardew Valley folder under [i][b]Content\Characters[/b][/i] and replace Harvey.xnb.

Thanks for downloading!
